label: Weekly Review
topic: Weekly Review / 本周复习 (工作效率＋分配律×25＋剩余＋括号／未知因数)
formulas: Rate × Time = Work；Remaining = Total − Done (剩余工作量)
Multi-agent unit rate: total ÷ trucks ÷ trips
[ ] then ( ): brackets first (带中括号四则)

questions.title: 分配律 ×25
questions.q: 用简便方法计算 448 × 25。正确结果是哪一个？

questions.title: Remaining work
questions.q: There are 5670 stickers to put on cards. Emma puts on 315 stickers per hour. After she works for 8 hours, how many stickers are still left?
questions.explanation: Done = rate × time = 315 × 8. 315 × 8 = 2520 stickers. Remaining = 5670 − 2520 = 3150 stickers.

wrong.A: 2520 is how many she already put on, not how many are left. Subtract from the total: 5670 − 2520 = 3150.
wrong.C: 5355 looks like 5670 − 315 (only one hour). She worked 8 hours: done = 315 × 8 = 2520, left = 3150.
wrong.D: 2880 is not the remaining amount. Correct path: 315 × 8 = 2520 done, then 5670 − 2520 = 3150 left.

questions.mistakes: Reporting done instead of remaining; subtracting only one hour of work.

questions.title: 按效率推算天数
questions.q: 王阿姨 5 天缝了 1750 件衣服。照这样的速度，缝 2800 件衣服需要几天？

wrong.C: 10 可能来自 2800÷280 或把 5 天直接比例做错。正确是 2800÷350=8。
wrong.D: 4 天少于已知的 5 天，但工作量更大，天数应更多。2800÷350=8。

questions.mistakes: 没先求每天效率；比例算反。

questions.title: Multi-truck unit rate
questions.q: 4 trucks made 3 trips altogether and carried 8640 boxes of fruit. At this rate, how many boxes can 1 truck carry in 1 trip?
questions.explanation: Divide by both the number of trucks and the number of trips: 8640 ÷ 4 = 2160, then 2160 ÷ 3 = 720. So 1 truck in 1 trip carries 720 boxes. (Or 8640 ÷ 3 ÷ 4 = 720.)

wrong.A: 2160 only divides by the trucks (8640 ÷ 4). You still need to divide by the 3 trips.
wrong.B: 2880 only divides by the trips (8640 ÷ 3). You still need to divide by the 4 trucks.
wrong.D: 1080 is 8640 ÷ 8. Divide by trucks and trips separately: 8640 ÷ 4 ÷ 3 = 720.

questions.mistakes: Dividing by only trucks or only trips; inventing a combined divisor.

questions.title: 求未知因数
questions.mistakes: 除法估商偏差；未用乘法检验。

questions.title: Remaining after brackets + ×25 rate
questions.q: There are 9000 labels to stick. Oliver's rate is 48 × 25 labels per hour (use a smart way). He works for [3 + (6 − 2)] hours. How many labels are still left?
questions.explanation: Rate: 48 × 25 = 48 × 100 ÷ 4 = 4800 ÷ 4 = 1200 labels per hour. Hours inside brackets: (6 − 2) = 4, then [3 + 4] = 7 hours. Done = 1200 × 7 = 8400. Remaining = 9000 − 8400 = 600 labels.

wrong.A: 8400 is how many he already stuck, not how many are left. Subtract: 9000 − 8400 = 600.
wrong.C: 5400 would match using only 3 hours (1200 × 3 = 3600 done → 5400 left). Do the full bracket time: [3+(6−2)] = 7 hours.
wrong.D: 4200 would match using only (6−2)=4 hours (1200 × 4 = 4800 done → 4200 left). Include the outer 3 as well: 7 hours total.

questions.mistakes: Reporting done instead of remaining; ignoring part of the bracketed time; wrong ×25.
